note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the user-namespace conversion (25fbb6e890/d8427e4380): the TestVRRPNonOwnerMasterAnswersARPWithVirtualMACOnly unit gained only `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }` as its first statement and its build tag moved from integration&&linux to linux. userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-runs the one named test in a fresh user+net+mount namespace and returns false to the parent only when the child reported PASS or SKIP; a failing child, a non-zero exit, or a child that ran nothing calls t.Fatalf, so every assertion below the guard still fails the test when the behaviour breaks. Body otherwise byte-identical. RFC 3768 Section 6.4.3: "MUST respond to ARP requests for the IP address(es) associated with the virtual router." Fresh judgement: with the VIP installed by Ze's backend AddAddress on the virtual-MAC macvlan a LAN host's ARP request is answered; with the address removed (Backup state) no reply is seen, so a router that does not answer is detected. TestPromotionInstallsIPv4AddressOnVirtualMACDevice pins that promotion installs exactly that address on that device. Enforced.
